snippet.title: Farming Incremental But With Guns - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Farming Incremental But With Guns is a 3D incremental shooter in which you not only watch your money overflow, but also grow your crops big enough to block out the sun. Playtest available right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4651120/Farming_Incremental_But_With_Guns/
